Sanne had 18 kaarten. ze gaf er 11 aan Sem. hoeveel kaarten heeft Sanne nu? 7: 18 − 11 = 7.
Luuk heeft 40 pennen. als Luuk er 15 weggeeft, hoeveel heeft Luuk dan? 25: 40 − 15 = 25.
eerst had Luuk 40 pennen. daarna kreeg hij er 15 bij. hoeveel pennen heeft hij nu? 55: 40 + 15 = 55.
Luuk had 40 pennen. Sanne nam 15 pennen van hem af. hoeveel pennen heeft Luuk nu? 25: 40 − 15 = 25.

Sem heeft 9 appels. zijn vader heeft 4 appels. hoeveel appels heeft Sem? Sem heeft 9 appels.

de moeder van Emma heeft 6 boeken. hoeveel boeken heeft de moeder van Emma? de moeder van Emma heeft 6 boeken.

Ava had 15 books. she got some more books. now Ava has 21 books. how many books did Ava get? 6: 21 − 15 = 6.
Ben had 9 cards. he sold some of them. now he has 5 cards. how many cards did he sell? 4: 9 − 5 = 4.
Ann has 12 coins. Ann gives away 5. how many coins does Ann own now? Ann owns 7 coins: 12 − 5 = 7.
Ann has 12 coins. a quarter of them are red. how many coins are red? 3: 12 ÷ 4 = 3.
Dan has 20 apples. a quarter of them are blue. how many apples are not blue? step 1: 20 ÷ 4 = 5. step 2: 20 − 5 = 15. total: 15.
Carlos had 25 eggs. Ava gave Carlos 7 eggs. how many eggs does Carlos have now? Carlos has 32 eggs: 25 + 7 = 32.
Ben's father has 4 cards. how many cards does Ben's father have? Ben's father has 4 cards.

Carlos had 9 jars. Carlos sold 4 jars. how many jars does he have left? 5: 9 − 4 = 5.

Carla had 30 photos in the album. she added 12 new photos. how many photos does Carla have now? 42: 30 + 12 = 42.
Carlos counted that 9 guests came to the museum on the first day and 4 on the second. how many guests came in all? 13: 9 + 4 = 13.
every day Carla spends 30 hours on drawing, 12 hours on chess and 10 hours on reading. how many hours does Carla spend in all? 52: 30 + 12 + 10 = 52.
